M0.rule_en: Truth and traceability outrank speed; automate only observe/record/rank
M0.rule_zh: 真相与可溯优先于速度；自动化只做观察/记录/排序
M0.excludes_en: Names no workflow, tool or domain method - it only ranks principles when they collide.
M0.excludes_zh: 不提供流程、工具或领域方法；只在原则冲突时排优先级。

M1.rule_en: Context is a finite, scarce resource - curate, don't dump
M1.rule_zh: 上下文稀缺——精修，不要倾倒
M1.excludes_en: Does not judge what is true or what counts as done - only what enters the window.
M1.excludes_zh: 不判断真假与验收标准，只管什么进入窗口。

M2.rule_en: Externalize memory; advance incrementally; make every run resumable
M2.rule_zh: 记忆外部化；增量推进；每次运行可续接
M2.excludes_en: Does not verify results or choose direction - only keeps state resumable and runs idempotent.
M2.excludes_zh: 不判定结果或方向；只保证可恢复、可续跑、可重入。

M3.rule_en: Define done before work; verify the verifier; hard vs soft gates
M3.rule_zh: 先定义完成；验证验证器；硬门/软门分离
M3.excludes_en: Does not decide what to build or where evidence comes from - it defines and enforces done.
M3.excludes_zh: 不决定做什么、不负责取证；只定义并执行 done。

M4.rule_en: Every fact traceable to a primary source; uncertain means uncertain
M4.rule_zh: 每个事实可溯源；不确定即标注不确定
M4.excludes_en: Does not audit code correctness or guarantee the conclusion is true - it makes claims traceable and expression reviewable.
M4.excludes_zh: 不审计代码、不担保结论为真；只让断言可溯源、表达可复核。

M5.rule_zh: 信号→审计→变异→日志，人类把关
M5.excludes_en: Never edits an SSOT or publishes on its own - it proposes, gates and journals.
M5.excludes_zh: 不自行改 SSOT 或发布；只提案、过闸、记账。

M6.rule_en: Minimal toolset; biased errors; skills load progressively
M6.rule_zh: 最小工具集；偏向正确的错误；技能渐进加载
M6.excludes_en: Sets no policy or permissions - it shapes interfaces, minimality and load order.
M6.excludes_zh: 不定权限与流程；只定工具接口、最小集与加载顺序。

M7.rule_en: Single source of truth; reviewable diffs; no unsolicited destructive acts
M7.rule_zh: 单一事实来源；可审阅 diff；不擅自做破坏性动作
M7.excludes_en: Produces no content - it makes changes visible, reviewable and revertible.
M7.excludes_zh: 不生产内容；只让变更可见、可复核、可回退。

M8.rule_en: Explicit contracts; escalate decisions; hand off with state
M8.rule_zh: 显式契约；决策升级；带状态交接
M8.excludes_en: Does not grade the work or set the bar - it makes contracts, escalation and handoff explicit.
M8.excludes_zh: 不评判质量、不设定标准；只把契约、升级与交接写明白。
